data.text: That works for me, John—I’ll select 10 tons. My family taught me that a good catch should leave us able to fish again, and this agreement does that while giving everyone a fair income. If we ever start below 100 tons, let’s agree on a revised quota before fishing so we leave at least half the starting stock. Luke, you’re welcome at our table and on the lake as an equal. Will you take 10 tons with us?
